t: A Mysterious Enemy. Mirage Middle School
d: Raimon prepares for Mirage, while Wan-Chang struggles with demotion and a childhood friend on the rival side.
Wan-Chang starts against Mirage, hoping to face Harrold honestly, while Luke hides troubling news.
Coach Sharp's tactics level the match, and Wan-Chang learns the truth about his past from an old friend.
Raimon reaches the Saints Way semifinals and prepares to face Universal's so-called perfect players.
Arion regains his passion for football, while Sam encourages J.P. to try becoming a goalkeeper.
Raimon faces Universal in the semifinal, confident in real football until Arion spots a familiar face.
Victor tells Arion he is not playing seriously, leaving Arion worried about Sol Daystar's illness.
After the Universal match, Riccardo's emergency surgery leaves Raimon without its captain for the final.
Victor urges Arion to learn a special move, and Arion leads Raimon through intense secret training.
The Saints Way final begins, with Raimon and Fifth Sector's strongest team tied after the first half.
The stadium's gimmick troubles both teams as Kirkwood unites around its coach's words to beat Raimon.

t: The Arrival of Brave Samurai Musashi
d: Roma equalizes in the second half, while Langford Ash's selfish play threatens to divide Kirkwood.
After facing Kirkwood, Raimon trains as J.P. works through trial and error to gain a Fighting Spirit.
